strings.en: "Oh! Ain't that Momotaro-san? Figures I couldn't beat ya here!"{wait}"Momotaro-san! Follow this hole and you'll come out at Row Cave!"{wait}"There might be some buried treasures along the way, so go on in and have a look!"{wait}
